name: Inwidia
source:
She is the only female Black Knight beside Superbia and is the only member with wings that can fly. She uses a sword that can be used as a whip which resembles a spine, allowing her to specialize in mid-ranged and close combat.
[spoiler]Being an apostle of Index and a subordinate of [url=https://vndb.org/c3156]Georgius of the Rainbow[/url], she fought with the other members of the Punishment Squad against Liselotte in the past; and although she perished, Invidia was revived afterwards by [url=https://vndb.org/c3152]Misao[/url] using a artificial body.
Her Index name is "Elaine of the Dragon Skeleton". Later, it is revealed that she loves Sebastian (Ira).[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://11eyes.fandom.com/wiki/Invidia]11eyes wiki[/url]]
